doc: -- | The PSX backend for Screamer, at `a = Effect Unit`. Lowered `.psx` code
-- | The core is hand-written in `Screamer.Psx.Core`. Every element below is
-- | constant or a `Signal` of its type, as Screamer's own attributes do, and
-- | is given the target's value and the keyboard events their event.
imports: Screamer.Psx.Core (Attr, Key, Markup, Node, keyedHtmlElement, keyedSvgElement, onValueInput)

keyedElement.type: forall a. String -> Array (Attr a) -> Array (Tuple Key (Node a)) -> Node a
keyedElement.code: \tag -> if Array.elem tag svgElements then keyedSvgElement tag else keyedHtmlElement tag

element.type: forall a. Array (Attr a) -> Markup a -> Node a

svgElement.type: forall a. Array (Attr a) -> Markup a -> Node a

boolean.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v Boolean => v -> Attr a

string.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v String => v -> Attr a

number.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v Int => v -> Attr a

imports: Screamer.Psx (class Children, class KeyedChildren, class ToKey)
core: forall a. String -> Array (B.Attr a) -> B.Markup a -> B.Node a
forall a. String -> Array (B.Attr a) -> Array (Tuple B.Key (B.Node a)) -> B.Node a
forall k a. ToKey k => k -> B.Node a -> Tuple B.Key (B.Node a)
forall a. String -> String -> B.Attr a
forall c a. Children c a => c -> B.Markup a
forall c a. KeyedChildren c a => c -> Array (Tuple B.Key (B.Node a))
forall a. B.Markup a -> B.Node a
extra: -- | What a child hole takes: a string, a node, markup, a signal of a
-- | string or of markup, and arrays and `Maybe`s of those.
-- | What a child hole of a keyed parent takes: keyed literals and arrays of
-- | them, keyed by strings or by integers.
keyedChildHoles :: B.Node (Effect Unit) -> Array (Tuple B.Key (B.Node (Effect Unit)))
-- | Attributes take a signal of their type as well as a constant.
[ B.div [ B.class_ (pure "on" :: Signal String), B.hidden (pure true :: Signal Boolean), B.tabindex (pure 0 :: Signal Int) ] []
, B.input [ B.value (pure "" :: Signal String), B.checked (pure false :: Signal Boolean) ] []
